steps.code:
# Let's write a helper to parse song lines and find matching song IDs
import re

def parse_song_line(line):
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    # Split artists by comma
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    return title, artists

def find_song_id(line, access_token):
    title, artists = parse_song_line(line)
    # Search with the full line to get relevant results
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=line, access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
    if isinstance(results, dict) and 'message' in results:
        return None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # Check if all required artists are present
            if all(any(artist.lower() == sa for sa in song_artists) for artist in artists):
                return song['song_id']
    return None

# Test on first few songs
for line in song_lines[:3]:
    sid = find_song_id(line, spotify_access_token)
    print(f"{line} -> {sid}")
